scenes.budapest_toll: Chain Bridge entrance 1849: stone arch tower, chains, wooden toll booth, barrier, cobbles.
scenes.nile: Nile bank in ancient Egypt, golden hour, wheat, palms, distant pyramids.
scenes.tent: 1500s explorers' tent interior, lanterns, parchment map table.
scenes.roadster: Cherry-red convertible sports car (no logos) floating in space with spacesuit mannequin driver, Earth limb in lower third, sun top-left. Landmarks: car 510,620; driver 735,420.
scenes.earth: Whole Earth (Americas) from space, centre 512,672, radius ~465, black starfield.
scenes.launch: Triple-core heavy rocket on seaside pad at dawn, tower right; centre-core nose ~512,150.
scenes.dash: Red convertible interior in space, steering wheel left, blank green dashboard screen centre 742,640, Earth through windscreen.
scenes.stars: Dark starfield, purple/blue nebula edges, empty centre (diagram background).
scenes.obs: Mountaintop observatory at night, dome lower right, Milky Way sky, rocky ground lower middle.
scenes.roswell_ranch: 1947 New Mexico ranch at golden hour, foil/rubber/stick debris across lower half, windmill right, mesas. Debris ~y 900-1450.

scenes.roswell_today: Modern desert town at dusk: alien-head green streetlights, flying-saucer building right, space murals; empty street lower half.
scenes.centralia_pit: 1962 Pennsylvania strip-mine pit used as a dump: grey rock walls with coal layers, trash burning with orange flames and grey smoke, wooded ridges, row houses on the ridge. Flames ~630,720.
scenes.centralia_road: Abandoned cracked two-lane highway today, steam rising from cracks, faded paint swirls (no letters), dirt mounds, autumn trees, overcast. Main cracks/steam ~512,790.
scenes.centralia_hole: 1980s coal-town backyard in winter: narrow steaming hole in the grass, wooden fence, back of brick row house, bare trees. Hole ~512,770.
scenes.centralia_town: Bird's-eye aerial of a 1960s Pennsylvania coal town: grid of brick row houses (~x 20-900, y 140-780), diagonal highway, river top-left, open-pit mine at right edge, open field lower middle.
scenes.liberty_suez: Suez Canal entrance at Port Said, late 1860s: stone breakwater + lighthouse left, sailing ships + paddle steamer, canal into desert, sandy quay lower half. Landmarks: canal mouth ~560,330; empty ground y 800-1500.
scenes.liberty_paris: Paris street 1884, wet cobbles, Haussmann buildings both sides, giant copper-brown Statue of Liberty in scaffolding above the rooftops. Statue bbox ~440,20 - 680,560.
scenes.liberty_crates: New York dock June 1885: stacks of plain wooden crates both sides, three-masted steam frigate behind, crane with hanging crate left, open plank dock lower middle.
scenes.liberty_harbour: Bird's-eye of Liberty Island in Upper NY Bay: island centre ~455,850 (spans x 110-780, y 670-1020), statue ~520,640, NJ park shore top-left, Manhattan skyline top-right, ferry ~820,480, pier to ~918,855.
scenes.centralia_dio_cold: 3D isometric cutaway diorama: coal town on top of an earth block, strip-mine pit right, two rows of dark empty mine tunnels + 2 shafts inside, navy background.
scenes.centralia_dio_hot: Same diorama edited: all tunnels and shafts burning orange, smoke from pit and cracks (pixel-aligned with centralia_dio_cold).
scenes.kola_rig: 1970s Soviet Arctic drilling site at polar dusk: tall steel derrick at left over a lit long building, snowy tundra, faint green aurora. Landscape 1536x1024; rig ~240,180; open snow lower middle.
scenes.kola_cap: Abandoned Arctic research site today: concrete ruins, rusty scrap, snow + moss; small rusty welded cap on cracked concrete lower-left (~370,850 of 1536x1024).

scenes.pacific: Open South Pacific at midday from just above the water: deep blue waves, tiny distant rocky islet with seabirds on the horizon; open water lower middle. 1536x1024.
scenes.korea_office: 1945 US government office late at night: desk left with unfolded East Asia map under green lamp (~250,300), rotary phone, night window with city lights top centre, wall clock top right, polished wooden floor lower middle empty.
scenes.korea_sign: 1953 plain wooden armistice signing hall: two long green-felt tables left and right with blank documents, wooden chairs, bright windows at back, empty wooden floor down the middle.
scenes.korea_dmz: Korean DMZ at misty dawn: wetland + young forest, double barbed-wire fence across middle distance (~y 300-330), guard tower right, mountains, red-crowned cranes in the shallows lower half (y ~1150-1500).

scenes.blr_ridge: 3D isometric cutaway diorama on navy: land block with a ridge, toy city on top (~602,333), dry slopes, blue river at the bottom-left edge (~180,770 to 475,1050). (Bengaluru)
scenes.blr_casc0: 3D isometric diorama on navy: sloping valley with 5 empty cracked tank basins stepping down from top-right to bottom-left (~781,218 / 666,410 / 563,614 / 461,858 / 346,1075), earth bunds, sluice gates, dry canals. (Bengaluru)

scenes.blr_busstand: Dusk aerial of a huge city bus terminal: semicircular lit canopy, rows of plain red/white and blue/white buses (~512,576), empty bus lane lower half. (Bengaluru)
